text: {"532":{"about":["rustc_ast"],"refers":[],"why":"`rustc_ast` defines the compiler token representation, including special end-of-file tokens."},"533":{"about":["rustc_ast","rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"`rustc_ast` represents token trees, while `rustc_parse` lexes and groups balanced delimited token trees."},"534":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"`rustc_expand` performs macro expansion over token streams, whose representation is defined by `rustc_ast`."},"535":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_span"],"why":"Macro expansion is implemented by `rustc_expand`, while source line and column information belongs to span infrastructure."},"536":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"The statement describes macro expansion's abstraction over token streams, which are represented by `rustc_ast`."}}
